title: BISE Academic Certificate & Degree Verification Procedure
content: Official academic certificate verification procedure for employment, foreign embassy attestation (IBCC), and international university admissions. Applicants must submit original Matric or Intermediate result cards, verified CNIC or B-Form copy, and two passport-sized photographs. Normal verification fee is PKR 2,000 per certificate with a standard turnaround time of 7 business working days. Urgent express verification is processed within 24 to 48 hours upon payment of PKR 4,000 urgent fee. Each verified certificate receives a tamper-proof holographic security seal, embossed board stamp, and a unique 2D cryptographic QR barcode allowing foreign embassies and academic institutions to verify authentic result records directly on the BISE central server.
